title: WaterColor 1650 E. County Hwy 30A #301
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 4 wristbands.- 2 adult bikes provided- Gulf views- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Delight in the picturesque setting of 1650 E. Scenic Highway 30A #301, a charming 1-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo nestled within desirable WaterColor, sleeping 4. Guests will love that this home includes access to multiple community pools, the private WaterColor Beach Club, and WaterColor’s countless additional amenities.Natural light illuminates the beadboard paneling and refinished hardwood floors inside this idyllic condo, featuring an abundance of windows and refined furnishings. The open-concept floor plan of the living, dining, and kitchen areas lets guests move and converse freely between the spaces. Prepare a local seafood feast in the kitchen with high-end appliances and granite countertops before dining at the 4-person dining table in the windowed alcove. There are 2 more seats at the bar. Afterwards, relax in the living area, where a comfortable couch and 2 armchairs surround the 47” TV. Out the back door is a quiet, shaded balcony with an outdoor table that seats 4.Upstairs is the primary bedroom with a king bed, private bathroom, 42” TV, and a cozy window seat. Through the hall door, discover the second-floor balcony with 4 cushioned chairs and Gulf views—an enchanting spot to sip coffee or tea while basking in the morning sunlight.Enjoy resort-style amenities and Gulf views at WaterColor’s 1650 E. Scenic Highway 30A #301. Guests can choose between private beach access at the beach club in main WaterColor or public beach access at Van Ness Butler and Santa Clara. There is on-site parking for 2 vehicles, and guests who prefer to explore on 2-wheels will appreciate the 2 complimentary adult bikes. Book this magical beach condo today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: FIRST FLOOR:Additional Sleeping Area: Queen Sleeper Sofa in the Living RoomSECOND FLOOR:Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Bathroom With ShowerWATERCOLOR NEIGHBORHOOD HIGHLIGHTS: - Named the #1 family vacation destination in the U.S.- A 499-acre coastal resort and residential community- Ideal bike community perfect for family getaways- Pristine sugar sand beaches- 6 swimming pools- Pickle ball courts- Award-winning tennis facilities- Championship golf nearby- World Famous Beach Club- Unparalleled beachside, poolside, and lakeside dining- Acres of parks, gardens, and footpaths- Nearby state parks and preserves*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments as well as be subject to HOA, community and 360 Blue fines.*Please note: Effective January 11th 2024, Watercolor Community HOA will no longer allow Low-Speed Vehicles to be rented by guests staying in the Town Center Condos.
